items.source: Name of token claim to use for mapping authorities from JWT.
items.translation: 用于从 JWT 映射权限的令牌声明名称。

items.source: Prefix to use for authorities mapped from JWT.
items.translation: 用于从 JWT 映射的权限的前缀。

items.source: URI that can either be an OpenID Connect discovery endpoint or an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata endpoint defined by RFC 8414.
items.translation: 可以是 OpenID Connect 发现端点或 RFC 8414 定义的 OAuth 2.0 授权服务器元数据端点的 URI。

items.source: JSON Web Key URI to use to verify the JWT token.
items.translation: 用于验证 JWT 令牌的 JSON Web Key URI。

items.source: JSON Web Algorithms used for verifying the digital signatures.
items.translation: 用于验证数字签名的 JSON Web 算法。

items.source: JWT principal claim name.
items.translation: JWT 主声明名称。

items.source: Location of the file containing the public key used to verify a JWT.
items.translation: 包含用于验证 JWT 的公钥的文件位置。

items.source: Client id used to authenticate with the token introspection endpoint.
items.translation: 用于与令牌内省端点（token introspection endpoint）进行身份验证的客户端 ID。

items.source: Client secret used to authenticate with the token introspection endpoint.
items.translation: 用于与令牌内省端点（token introspection endpoint）进行身份验证的客户端密钥。

items.source: OAuth 2.0 endpoint through which token introspection is accomplished.
items.translation: 用于实现令牌检查的 OAuth 2.0 端点。

items.source: SAML2 relying party registrations.
items.translation: SAML2 依赖方注册。

items.source: Default user name.
items.translation: 默认用户名。

items.source: Password for the default user name.
items.translation: 默认用户名的密码。

items.source: Granted roles for the default user name.
items.translation: 默认用户名的授予角色。

items.source: Whether response compression is enabled.
items.translation: 是否启用响应压缩。

items.source: Comma-separated list of user agents for which responses should not be compressed.
items.translation: 不应压缩响应的用户代理的逗号分隔列表。

items.source: Comma-separated list of MIME types that should be compressed.
items.translation: 应压缩的 MIME 类型的逗号分隔列表。

items.source: Minimum "Content-Length" value that is required for compression to be performed.
items.translation: 执行压缩所需的最低“Content-Length"值。

items.source: Strategy for handling X-Forwarded-* headers.
items.translation: 处理 X-Forwarded-* 标头的策略。

items.source: Whether to enable HTTP/2 support, if the current environment supports it.
items.translation: 是否启用 HTTP/2 支持（如果当前环境支持）。

items.source: Append to log.
items.translation: 追加到日志。

items.source: Custom log format, see org.eclipse.jetty.server.CustomRequestLog. If defined, overrides the "format" configuration key.
items.translation: 自定义日志格式，参见 org.eclipse.jetty.server.CustomRequestLog。如果已定义，则覆盖“format”配置键。

items.source: Date format to place in log file name.
items.translation: 日志文件名中使用的日期格式。

items.source: Log filename. If not specified, logs redirect to "System.err".
items.translation: 日志文件名。如果未指定，日志将重定向到"System.err"。

items.source: Log format.
items.translation: 日志格式。

items.source: Request paths that should not be logged.
items.translation: 不应记录日志的请求路径。

items.source: Number of days before rotated log files are deleted.
items.translation: 旋转日志文件被删除前的天数。

items.source: Time that the connection can be idle before it is closed.
items.translation: 连接空闲后被关闭前的时间。

items.source: Maximum number of connections that the server accepts and processes at any given time.
items.translation: 服务器在任何给定时间接受和处理的最大连接数。

items.source: Maximum number of form keys.
items.translation: 表单键的最大数量。

items.source: Number of acceptor threads to use. When the value is -1, the default, the number of acceptors is derived from the operating environment.
items.translation: 要使用的接受者线程数。当该值为 -1（默认值）时，接受者的数量由运行环境推导得出。

items.source: Maximum thread idle time.
items.translation: 最大线程空闲时间。

items.source: Maximum number of threads. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.
items.translation: 线程的最大数量。如果启用了虚拟线程，则此设置无效。

items.source: Maximum capacity of the thread pool's backing queue. A default is computed based on the threading configuration.
items.translation: 线程池后备队列的最大容量。默认值将根据线程配置进行计算。

items.source: Minimum number of threads. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.
items.translation: 线程的最小数量。如果启用了虚拟线程，则此设置无效。

items.source: Number of selector threads to use. When the value is -1, the default, the number of selectors is derived from the operating environment.
items.translation: 要使用的选择器线程数。当值为 -1（默认值）时，选择器的数量由操作系统环境推导得出。

items.source: Maximum size of the HTTP request header. Refer to the documentation for your chosen embedded server for details of exactly how this limit is applied. For example, Netty applies the limit separately to each individual header in the request whereas Tomcat applies the limit to the combined size of the request line and all of the header names and values in the request.
items.translation: HTTP 请求头的最大大小。有关此限制如何应用的详细信息，请参阅您选择的嵌入式服务器的文档。例如，Netty 对请求中的每个单独头应用此限制，而 Tomcat 则将此限制应用于请求行和请求中所有头名称及值的总大小。

items.source: Connection timeout of the Netty channel.
items.translation: Netty 通道的连接超时。

items.source: Maximum content length of an H2C upgrade request.
items.translation: H2C 升级请求的最大内容长度。

items.source: Idle timeout of the Netty channel. When not specified, an infinite timeout is used.
items.translation: Netty 通道的空闲超时时间。如果不指定，则使用无限超时。

items.source: Initial buffer size for HTTP request decoding.
items.translation: HTTP 请求解码的初始缓冲区大小。

items.source: Maximum length that can be decoded for an HTTP request's initial line.
items.translation: HTTP 请求初始行可解码的最大长度。

items.source: Maximum number of requests that can be made per connection. By default, a connection serves unlimited number of requests.
items.translation: 每个连接可发出的请求的最大数量。默认情况下，一个连接可处理无限数量的请求。

items.source: Whether to validate headers when decoding requests.
items.translation: 解码请求时是否验证标头。

items.source: Server HTTP port.
items.translation: 服务器 HTTP 端口。

items.source: Maximum number of sessions that can be stored.
items.translation: 可存储的最大会话数。

items.source: Value to use for the Server response header (if empty, no header is sent).
items.translation: 用于服务器响应头的值（如果为空，则不发送任何头）。

items.source: Display name of the application.
items.translation: 应用程序的显示名称。

items.source: Servlet context init parameters.
items.translation: Servlet 上下文初始化参数。

items.source: Context path of the application.
items.translation: 应用程序的上下文路径。

items.source: Mapping of locale to charset for response encoding.
items.translation: 用于响应编码的本地化到字符集的映射。

items.source:
Class name of the servlet to use for JSPs. If registered is true and this class
	 * is on the classpath then it will be registered.
items.translation: 用于 JSP 的 Servlet 类名。如果已注册且该类在类路径中，则将其注册。

items.source: Init parameters used to configure the JSP servlet.
items.translation: 用于配置 JSP  servlet 的初始化参数。

items.source: Whether the JSP servlet is registered.
items.translation: JSP  servlet 是否已注册。

items.source: Whether to register the default Servlet with the container.
items.translation: 是否将默认 Servlet 注册到容器中。

items.source: Whether to persist session data between restarts.
items.translation: 是否在重启之间持久化会话数据。

items.source: Directory used to store session data.
items.translation: 用于存储会话数据的目录。

items.source: Session tracking modes.
items.translation: 会话跟踪模式。

items.source: Type of shutdown that the server will support.
items.translation: 服务器将支持的关闭类型。

items.source: Maximum queue length for incoming connection requests when all possible request processing threads are in use.
items.translation: 当所有可能的请求处理线程都在使用时，传入连接请求的最大队列长度。

items.source: Whether to buffer output such that it is flushed only periodically.
items.translation: 是否缓冲输出，使其仅定期刷新。

items.source: Whether to check for log file existence so it can be recreated if an external process has renamed it.
items.translation: 是否检查日志文件是否存在，以便在外部进程重命名该文件时能够重新创建它。

items.source: Whether logging of the request will only be enabled if "ServletRequest.getAttribute(conditionIf)" does not yield null.
items.translation: 无论是否仅在"ServletRequest.getAttribute(conditionIf)"未返回 null 时启用请求日志记录。

items.source: Whether logging of the request will only be enabled if "ServletRequest.getAttribute(conditionUnless)" yield null.
items.translation: 无论是否仅在"ServletRequest.getAttribute(conditionUnless)"返回 null 时启用请求日志记录。

items.source: Directory in which log files are created. Can be absolute or relative to the Tomcat base dir.
items.translation: 创建日志文件的目录。可以是绝对路径，也可以是相对于 Tomcat 基本目录的路径。

items.source: Character set used by the log file. Default to the system default character set.
items.translation: 日志文件使用的字符集。默认为系统默认字符集。

items.source: Date format to place in the log file name.
items.translation: 日志文件名中使用的日期格式。

items.source: Whether to use IPv6 canonical representation format as defined by RFC 5952.
items.translation: 是否使用由 RFC 5952 定义的 IPv6 规范表示格式。

items.source: Locale used to format timestamps in log entries and in log file name suffix. Default to the default locale of the Java process.
items.translation: 用于格式化日志条目和日志文件名后缀中时间戳的区域设置。默认为 Java 进程的区域设置。

items.source: Number of days to retain the access log files before they are removed.
items.translation: 在删除访问日志文件之前保留这些文件的天数。

items.source: Format pattern for access logs.
items.translation: 访问日志的格式模式。

items.source: Log file name prefix.
items.translation: 日志文件名前缀。

items.source: Whether to defer inclusion of the date stamp in the file name until rotate time.
items.translation: 是否将日期戳包含在文件名中的操作推迟到轮转时间。

items.source: Set request attributes for the IP address, Hostname, protocol, and port used for the request.
items.translation: 为请求中使用的 IP 地址、主机名、协议和端口设置请求属性。

items.source: Whether to enable access log rotation.
items.translation: 是否启用访问日志轮转。

items.source: Log file name suffix.
items.translation: 日志文件名后缀。

items.source: List of additional patterns that match jars to ignore for TLD scanning. The special '?' and '*' characters can be used in the pattern to match one and only one character and zero or more characters respectively.
items.translation: 忽略 TLD 扫描时用于匹配 jar 的其他模式列表。特殊字符 '?' 和 '*' 可用于模式中，分别匹配单个字符和零个或多个字符。

items.source: Delay between the invocation of backgroundProcess methods. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.
items.translation: backgroundProcess 方法调用之间的延迟。如果未指定持续时间后缀，则使用秒。

items.source: Tomcat base directory. If not specified, a temporary directory is used.
items.translation: Tomcat 基础目录。如果未指定，则使用临时目录。

items.source: Amount of time the connector will wait, after accepting a connection, for the request URI line to be presented.
items.translation: 连接器在接收连接后，等待请求 URI 行呈现的时间量。

items.source: Time to wait for another HTTP request before the connection is closed. When not set the connectionTimeout is used. When set to -1 there will be no timeout.
items.translation: 等待关闭连接之前另一个 HTTP 请求的时间。如果未设置，则使用 connectionTimeout。如果设置为 -1，则没有超时。

items.source: Maximum number of connections that the server accepts and processes at any given time. Once the limit has been reached, the operating system may still accept connections based on the "acceptCount" property.
items.translation: 服务器在任何给定时间接受和处理的最大连接数。一旦达到该限制，操作系统仍可能根据"acceptCount"属性接受连接。

items.source: Maximum number of HTTP requests that can be pipelined before the connection is closed. When set to 0 or 1, keep-alive and pipelining are disabled. When set to -1, an unlimited number of pipelined or keep-alive requests are allowed.
items.translation: 可管道化的 HTTP 请求的最大数量，在连接关闭之前。设置为 0 或 1 时，禁用保持活动状态和管道化。设置为 -1 时，允许无限数量的管道化或保持活动状态的请求。

items.source: Maximum number of parameters (GET plus POST) that will be automatically parsed by the container. A value of less than 0 means no limit.
items.translation: 容器将自动解析的参数（GET 和 POST）的最大数量。小于 0 的值表示没有限制。

items.source: Maximum total number of parts permitted in a multipart/form-data request. Requests that exceed this limit will be rejected. A value of less than 0 means no limit.
items.translation: multipart/form-data 请求中允许的最大部分总数。超过此限制的请求将被拒绝。小于 0 的值表示无限制。

items.source: Maximum per-part header size permitted in a multipart/form-data request. Requests that exceed this limit will be rejected. A value of less than 0 means no limit.
items.translation: multipart/form-data 请求中允许的每个部分的最大标头大小。超过此限制的请求将被拒绝。小于 0 的值表示无限制。

items.source: Maximum amount of request body to swallow.
items.translation: 要吞没的请求体的最大量。

items.source: Whether Tomcat's MBean Registry should be enabled.
items.translation: 是否应启用 Tomcat 的 MBean 注册表。

items.source: Maximum number of idle processors that will be retained in the cache and reused with a subsequent request. When set to -1 the cache will be unlimited with a theoretical maximum size equal to the maximum number of connections.
items.translation: 保留在缓存中并在后续请求中复用的最大空闲处理器数量。当设置为 -1 时，缓存将没有限制，其理论最大大小等于最大连接数。

items.source: Whether requests to the context root should be redirected by appending a / to the path. When using SSL terminated at a proxy, this property should be set to false.
items.translation: 是否应将请求重定向到上下文根，并在路径后追加一个 `/`。当在代理处终止 SSL 时，此属性应设置为 false。

items.source: List of additional unencoded characters that should be allowed in URI paths. Only "< > [ \ ] ^ ` { | }" are allowed.
items.translation: 应允许在 URI 路径中包含的额外未编码字符列表。仅允许 "< > [ \ ] ^ ` { | }"。

items.source: List of additional unencoded characters that should be allowed in URI query strings. Only "< > [ \ ] ^ ` { | }" are allowed.
items.translation: < 允许在 URI 查询字符串中包含的额外未编码字符列表。仅允许 "< > [ \ ] ^ ` { | }"。

items.source: Name of the HTTP header from which the remote host is extracted.
items.translation: 提取远程主机的 HTTP 头名称。

items.source: Internal proxies that are to be trusted. Can be set as a comma separate list of CIDR or as a regular expression.
items.translation: 受信任的内部代理。可以设置为 CIDR 的逗号分隔列表，或正则表达式。

items.source: Name of the HTTP header used to override the original port value.
items.translation: 用于覆盖原始端口值的 HTTP 头名称。

items.source: Header that holds the incoming protocol, usually named "X-Forwarded-Proto".
items.translation: 包含传入协议的标头，通常命名为"X-Forwarded-Proto"。

items.source: Value of the protocol header indicating whether the incoming request uses SSL.
items.translation: 指示传入请求是否使用 SSL 的协议头值。

items.source: Name of the HTTP header from which the remote IP is extracted. For instance, 'X-FORWARDED-FOR'.
items.translation: 提取远程 IP 的 HTTP 标头名称。例如，'X-FORWARDED-FOR'。

items.source: Regular expression defining proxies that are trusted when they appear in the "remote-ip-header" header.
items.translation: 定义当出现在"remote-ip-header"标头中时受信任的代理的正则表达式。

items.source: Whether static resource caching is permitted for this web application.
items.translation: 是否允许为此 Web 应用程序启用静态资源缓存。

items.source: Maximum size of the static resource cache.
items.translation: 静态资源缓存的最大大小。

items.source: Time-to-live of the static resource cache.
items.translation: 静态资源缓存的生存时间 (TTL)。

items.source: Maximum amount of worker threads. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.
items.translation: 工作线程的最大数量。如果启用了虚拟线程，则此设置无效。

items.source: Maximum capacity of the thread pool's backing queue. This setting only has an effect if the value is greater than 0.
items.translation: 线程池后备队列的最大容量。此设置仅在值大于 0 时生效。

items.source: Minimum amount of worker threads. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.
items.translation: 工作线程的最小数量。如果启用了虚拟线程，则此设置无效。

items.source: Character encoding to use to decode the URI.
items.translation: 用于解码 URI 的字符编码。

items.source: Whether to use APR.
items.translation: 是否使用 APR。

items.source: Whether HTTP 1.1 and later location headers generated by a call to sendRedirect will use relative or absolute redirects.
items.translation: 由 `sendRedirect` 调用生成的 HTTP 1.1 及更高版本的 Location 头将使用相对还是绝对重定向。

items.source: Whether HttpServletRequest attributes are allowed to override (hide) controller generated model attributes of the same name. Only supported with Spring MVC.
items.translation: HttpServletRequest 属性是否允许覆盖（隐藏）同名的控制器生成的模型属性。仅支持 Spring MVC。

items.source: Whether HttpSession attributes are allowed to override (hide) controller generated model attributes of the same name. Only supported with Spring MVC.
items.translation: HttpSession 属性是否允许覆盖（隐藏）同名控制器生成的模型属性。仅支持 Spring MVC。

items.source: Whether to enable template caching. Only supported with Spring MVC.
items.translation: 是否启用模板缓存。仅支持 Spring MVC。

items.source: Content-Type value. Only supported with Spring MVC.
items.translation: Content-Type 值。仅支持 Spring MVC。

items.source: Whether all request attributes should be added to the model prior to merging with the template. Only supported with Spring MVC.
items.translation: 是否应在与模板合并之前将所有请求属性添加到模型中。仅支持 Spring MVC。

items.source: Whether all HttpSession attributes should be added to the model prior to merging with the template. Only supported with Spring MVC.
items.translation: 是否应在与模板合并之前将所有 HttpSession 属性添加到模型中。仅支持 Spring MVC。

items.source: Whether to expose a RequestContext for use by Spring's macro library, under the name "springMacroRequestContext". Only supported with Spring MVC.
items.translation: 是否暴露一个 RequestContext 供 Spring 宏库使用，名称为"springMacroRequestContext"。仅支持 Spring MVC。

items.source: Whether to prefer file system access for template loading to enable hot detection of template changes. When a template path is detected as a directory, templates are loaded from the directory only and other matching classpath locations will not be considered.
items.translation: 是否优先使用文件系统访问来加载模板，以启用模板更改的热检测。当检测到模板路径为目录时，仅从该目录加载模板，而不会考虑其他匹配类路径位置。

items.source: Well-known FreeMarker keys which are passed to FreeMarker's Configuration.
items.translation: 知名且会传递给 FreeMarker 配置的 FreeMarker 键。

items.source: List of template paths.
items.translation: 模板路径列表。

items.source: Whether models that are assignable to CharSequence are escaped automatically.
items.translation: 是否会自动转义可分配给 CharSequence 的模型。

items.source: Whether indents are rendered automatically.
items.translation: 是否自动渲染缩进。

items.source: String used for auto-indents.
items.translation: 用于自动缩进的字符串。

items.source: Whether new lines are rendered automatically.
items.translation: 是否自动渲染换行符。

items.source: Template base class.
items.translation: 模板基类。

items.source: Encoding used to write the declaration heading.
items.translation: 用于编写声明标题的编码。

items.source: Whether elements without a body should be written expanded (<br></br>) or not (<br/>).
items.translation: 没有主体元素的元素是否应以展开形式书写（<br></br>）还是不以展开形式书写（<br/>）。

items.source: Default locale for template resolution.
items.translation: 模板解析的默认区域设置。

items.source: String used to write a new line. Defaults to the system's line separator.
items.translation: 用于写入新行的 String。默认为系统的行分隔符。

items.source: Template path.
items.translation: 模板路径。

items.source: Whether attributes should use double quotes.
items.translation: 属性是否应使用双引号。

items.source: Prefix to apply to template names.
items.translation: 要应用于模板名称的前缀。

items.source: Media types supported by Mustache views.
items.translation: Mustache 视图支持的媒体类型。

items.source: Suffix to apply to template names.
items.translation: 要应用于模板名称的后缀。

items.source: Whether to check that the template exists before rendering it.
items.translation: 是否在渲染模板之前检查其是否存在。

items.source: Enable the SpringEL compiler in SpringEL expressions.
items.translation: 在 SpringEL 表达式中启用 SpringEL 编译器。

items.source: Template files encoding.
items.translation: 模板文件编码。

items.source: List of view names (patterns allowed) that should be excluded from resolution.
items.translation: 应排除在解析之外的视图名称列表（允许使用模式）。

items.source: Template mode to be applied to templates. See also Thymeleaf's TemplateMode enum.
items.translation: 要应用于模板的模板模式。另请参阅 Thymeleaf 的 TemplateMode 枚举。

items.source: Comma-separated list of view names (patterns allowed) that should be the only ones executed in CHUNKED mode when a max chunk size is set.
items.translation: 应仅在设置最大块大小时以分块模式执行的视图名称（允许使用模式）的逗号分隔列表。

items.source: Comma-separated list of view names (patterns allowed) that should be executed in FULL mode even if a max chunk size is set.
items.translation: 应在全模式下执行的视图名称（允许使用模式）的逗号分隔列表，即使设置了最大块大小。

items.source: Maximum size of data buffers used for writing to the response. Templates will execute in CHUNKED mode by default if this is set.
items.translation: 写入响应时使用的数据缓冲区的最大大小。如果设置此值，模板将默认以 CHUNKED 模式执行。

items.source: Media types supported by the view technology.
items.translation: 视图技术支持的媒体类型。

items.source: Whether hidden form inputs acting as markers for checkboxes should be rendered before the checkbox element itself.
items.translation: 作为复选框标记的隐藏表单输入是否应在复选框元素之前渲染。

items.source: Content-Type value written to HTTP responses.

items.translation: 测试中是否应自动配置跟踪导出。

items.translation: 是否应自动配置 MockWebServiceServer。

items.translation: 是否应注册 WebServiceTemplate 类型的 Bean。

items.translation: 是否启用 JTA 支持。

items.translation: 默认事务超时时间。如果未指定持续时间后缀，将使用秒。

items.source: Whether to roll back on commit failures.
items.translation: 是否在提交失败时回滚。

items.source: List of HTTP headers to allow in a request. '*' allows all headers.
items.translation: 允许在请求中使用的 HTTP 头列表。'*' 允许所有头。

items.source: List of HTTP methods to allow. '*' allows all methods. When not set, defaults to GET.
items.translation: 允许使用的 HTTP 方法列表。'*' 表示允许所有方法。未设置时，默认为 GET。

items.source: List of origin patterns to allow. Unlike allowed origins which only support '*', origin patterns are more flexible, e.g. 'https://*.example.com', and can be used with allow-credentials. When neither allowed origins nor allowed origin patterns are set, cross-origin requests are effectively disabled.
items.translation: 允许的原型模式列表。与仅支持 '*' 的允许来源不同，原型模式更灵活，例如 'https://*.example.com'，并且可与 allow-credentials 一起使用。当未设置允许的来源或允许的原型模式时，跨域请求实际上会被禁用。

items.source: List of origins to allow with '*' allowing all origins. When allow-credentials is enabled, '*' cannot be used, and setting origin patterns should be considered instead. When neither allowed origins nor allowed origin patterns are set, cross-origin requests are effectively disabled.
items.translation: 允许的来源列表，其中 '*' 表示允许所有来源。当启用 allow-credentials 时，不能使用 '*'，而应考虑设置来源模式。如果未设置允许的来源或允许的来源模式，跨域请求实际上将被禁用。

items.source: Whether the default GraphiQL UI is enabled.
items.translation: 默认 GraphiQL UI 是否已启用。

items.translation: GraphiQL UI 端点的路径。

items.source: Path at which to expose a GraphQL request HTTP endpoint.
items.translation: 暴露 GraphQL 请求 HTTP 端点的路径。

items.source: How frequently keep-alive messages should be sent.
items.translation: 应发送 keep-alive 消息的频率。

items.translation: 并发处理完成所需的时间。

items.source: Mapping of the RSocket message handler.

items.source: Preferred JSON mapper to use. By default, auto-detected according to the environment. Supported values are 'jackson' and 'jackson2' (deprecated).
items.translation: 首选的 JSON 映射器。默认情况下，根据环境自动检测。支持的值是 'jackson' 和 'jackson2'（已弃用）。

items.source: Locations of additional, individual schema files to parse.
items.translation: 用于解析的额外、独立模式文件的位置。

items.source: File extensions for GraphQL schema files.
items.translation: GraphQL 架构文件的文件扩展名。

items.source: Whether schema should be compared to the application to detect missing mappings.
items.translation: 是否应将模式与应用程序进行比较以检测缺失的映射。

items.source: Whether field introspection should be enabled at the schema level.
items.translation: 是否应在模式级别启用字段内省。

items.source: Locations of GraphQL schema files.
items.translation: GraphQL 架构文件的位置。

items.source: Whether the endpoint that prints the schema is enabled. Schema is available under spring.graphql.http.path + "/schema".
items.translation: 是否启用了打印模式的端点。模式可在 `spring.graphql.http.path` + "/schema" 下获取。

items.source: Time within which the initial {@code CONNECTION_INIT} type message must be received.
items.translation: 接收初始{@code CONNECTION_INIT}类型消息的时间范围。

items.source: Maximum idle period before a server keep-alive ping is sent to client.
items.translation: 发送服务器保持活动状态 ping 到客户端之前的最大空闲时间。

items.source: Path of the GraphQL WebSocket subscription endpoint.
items.translation: GraphQL WebSocket 订阅端点的路径。

items.source: Whether application/hal+json responses should be sent to requests that accept application/json.
items.translation: 是否应将 application/hal+json 响应发送给接受 application/json 的请求。

items.source: Default connect timeout for a client HTTP request.
items.translation: 客户端 HTTP 请求的默认连接超时时间。

items.source: Default factory used for a client HTTP request.
items.translation: 用于客户端 HTTP 请求的默认工厂。

items.source: Default connector used for a client HTTP request.
items.translation: 客户端 HTTP 请求使用的默认连接器。

items.source: Default read timeout for a client HTTP request.
items.translation: 客户端 HTTP 请求的默认读取超时时间。

items.source: Handling for HTTP redirects.
items.translation: 处理 HTTP 重定向。

items.source: SSL bundle to use.
items.translation: 要使用的 SSL 包。

items.source: Whether to log form data at DEBUG level, and headers at TRACE level.
items.translation: 是否以 DEBUG 级别记录表单数据，并以 TRACE 级别记录标头。

items.source: Limit on the number of bytes that can be buffered whenever the input stream needs to be aggregated. This applies only to the auto-configured WebFlux server and WebClient instances. By default this is not set, in which case individual codec defaults apply. Most codecs are limited to 256K by default.
items.translation: 输入流需要聚合时，可缓冲字节数的限制。此设置仅适用于自动配置的 WebFlux 服务器和 WebClient 实例。默认情况下未设置此项，此时将应用各个编解码器的默认值。大多数编解码器的默认限制为 256K。

items.source: Preferred JSON mapper to use for HTTP encoding and decoding. By default, auto-detected according to the environment. Supported values are 'jackson' and 'jackson2' (deprecated).
items.translation: 用于 HTTP 编码和解码的首选 JSON 映射器。默认情况下，根据环境自动检测。支持的值包括 'jackson' 和 'jackson2'（已弃用）。

items.source: Preferred JSON mapper to use for HTTP message conversion. By default, auto-detected according to the environment. Supported values are 'jackson', 'jackson2' (deprecated), 'gson' and 'jsonb'. When other JSON mapping libraries are present, use a custom HttpMessageConverters bean to control the preferred mapper.
items.translation: 用于 HTTP 消息转换的首选 JSON 映射器。默认情况下，根据环境自动检测。支持的值包括 'jackson'、'jackson2'（已弃用）、'gson' 和 'jsonb'。当存在其他 JSON 映射库时，请使用自定义的 HttpMessageConverters Bean 来控制首选映射器。

items.source: Charset to use for String conversion.
items.translation: 用于字符串转换的字符集。

items.source: HTTP Service Client definitions
items.translation: HTTP 服务客户端定义

items.source: Path that serves as the base URI for the application. If specified, overrides the value of "@ApplicationPath".
items.translation: 作为应用程序基础 URI 的路径。如果指定，将覆盖"@ApplicationPath"的值。

items.source: Jersey filter chain order.
items.translation: Jersey 过滤器链顺序。

items.source: Init parameters to pass to Jersey through the servlet or filter.
items.translation: 通过 servlet 或过滤器传递给 Jersey 的初始化参数。

items.source: Load on startup priority of the Jersey servlet.
items.translation: Jerby Servlet 的启动加载优先级。

items.source: Jersey integration type.
items.translation: Jersey 集成类型。

items.source: Amount of time before asynchronous request handling times out. If this value is not set, the default timeout of the underlying implementation is used.
items.translation: 异步请求处理超时的时间量。如果未设置此值，则使用底层实现的默认超时时间。

items.source: List of default content types to be used when no specific content type is requested.
items.translation: 当未请求特定内容类型时，将使用的默认内容类型列表。

items.source: Whether a request parameter ("format" by default) should be used to determine the requested media type.
items.translation: 是否应使用请求参数（默认为 "format"）来确定请求的媒体类型。

items.source: Map file extensions to media types for content negotiation. For instance, yml to text/yaml.
items.translation: 将文件扩展名映射到媒体类型以进行内容协商。例如，将 yml 映射为 text/yaml。

items.source: Query parameter name to use when "favor-parameter" is enabled.
items.translation: 启用“favor-parameter”时使用的查询参数名称。

items.source: Whether to dispatch OPTIONS requests to the FrameworkServlet doService method.
items.translation: 是否将 OPTIONS 请求分派到 FrameworkServlet 的 doService 方法。

items.source: Whether to dispatch TRACE requests to the FrameworkServlet doService method.
items.translation: 是否将 TRACE 请求分派到 FrameworkServlet 的 doService 方法。

items.source: Whether to enable Spring's FormContentFilter.
items.translation: 是否启用 Spring 的 FormContentFilter。

items.source: Whether logging of (potentially sensitive) request details at DEBUG and TRACE level is allowed.
items.translation: 是否允许在 DEBUG 和 TRACE 级别记录（可能敏感的）请求详细信息。

items.source: Whether to enable warn logging of exceptions resolved by a "HandlerExceptionResolver", except for "DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver".
items.translation: 是否启用由"HandlerExceptionResolver"（"DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver"除外）解析的异常的警告日志。

items.source: Formatting strategy for message codes. For instance, 'PREFIX_ERROR_CODE'.
items.translation: 消息代码的格式化策略。例如，'PREFIX_ERROR_CODE'。

items.source: Choice of strategy for matching request paths against registered mappings.
items.translation: 用于将请求路径与已注册映射进行匹配的策略选择。

items.source: Whether to publish a ServletRequestHandledEvent at the end of each request.
items.translation: 是否在每次请求结束时发布 ServletRequestHandledEvent。

items.source: Load on startup priority of the dispatcher servlet.
items.translation: 启动时加载的 DispatcherServlet 优先级。

items.source: Path of the dispatcher servlet. Setting a custom value for this property is not compatible with the PathPatternParser matching strategy.
items.translation: DispatcherServlet 的路径。为自定义此属性值与 PathPatternParser 匹配策略不兼容。

items.source: Spring MVC view prefix.
items.translation: Spring MVC 视图前缀。

items.source: Spring MVC view suffix.
items.translation: Spring MVC 视图后缀。

items.source: Level of leak detection for reference-counted buffers. If not configured via 'ResourceLeakDetector.setLevel' or the 'io.netty.leakDetection.level' system property, default to 'simple'.
items.translation: 引用计数缓冲区的内存泄漏检测级别。如果未通过 'ResourceLeakDetector.setLevel' 或 'io.netty.leakDetection.level' 系统属性进行配置，则默认为'simple'。

items.source: Charset of HTTP requests and responses. Added to the "Content-Type" header if not set explicitly.
items.translation: HTTP 请求和响应的字符集。如果未显式设置，则添加到"Content-Type"标头中。

items.source: Whether to enable Servlet HTTP encoding support.
items.translation: 是否启用 Servlet HTTP 编码支持。

items.source: Whether to force the encoding to the configured charset on HTTP requests and responses.
items.translation: 是否在 HTTP 请求和响应中强制将编码设置为配置的字符集。

items.source: Whether to force the encoding to the configured charset on HTTP requests. Defaults to true when "force" has not been specified.
items.translation: 是否在 HTTP 请求中将编码强制为配置的字符集。当未指定"force"时，默认值为 true。

items.source: Whether to force the encoding to the configured charset on HTTP responses.
items.translation: 是否在 HTTP 响应中将编码强制为配置的字符集。

items.source: Whether to enable support of multipart uploads.
items.translation: 是否启用多部分上传支持。

items.source: Threshold after which files are written to disk.
items.translation: 写入磁盘的阈值。

items.source: Intermediate location of uploaded files.
items.translation: 上传文件的中间位置。

items.source: Max file size.
items.translation: 最大文件大小。

items.source: Max request size.
items.translation: 最大请求大小。

items.source: Whether to resolve the multipart request lazily at the time of file or parameter access.
items.translation: 是否在访问文件或参数时懒式解析多部分请求。

items.source: Whether to resolve the multipart request strictly complying with the Servlet specification, only to be used for "multipart/form-data" requests.
items.translation: 是否严格遵循 Servlet 规范解析多部分请求，仅用于 "multipart/form-data" 请求。

items.source: Cron expression for expired session cleanup job. Only supported when repository-type is set to indexed. Not supported with a reactive session repository.
items.translation: 用于过期会话清理任务的 Cron 表达式。仅当 repository-type 设置为 indexed 时支持，不支持使用响应式会话存储库。

items.source: The configure action to apply when no user-defined ConfigureRedisAction or ConfigureReactiveRedisAction bean is present.
items.translation: 当不存在用户定义的 `ConfigureRedisAction` 或 `ConfigureReactiveRedisAction` Bean 时，将应用此配置操作。

items.source: Sessions flush mode. Determines when session changes are written to the session store. Not supported with a reactive session repository.
items.translation: 会话刷新模式。确定何时将会话更改写入会话存储。不支持使用响应式会话存储库。

items.source: Namespace for keys used to store sessions.
items.translation: 用于存储会话的键的命名空间。

items.source: Type of Redis session repository to configure.
items.translation: 要配置的 Redis 会话存储类型。

items.source: Cron expression for expired session cleanup job.
items.translation: 用于过期会话清理任务的 Cron 表达式。

items.source: Sessions flush mode. Determines when session changes are written to the session store.
items.translation: 会话刷新模式。确定何时将会话更改写入会话存储。

items.source: Name of the database table used to store sessions.
items.translation: 用于存储会话的数据库表名称。

items.source: Session repository filter dispatcher types.
items.translation: 会话存储库过滤器分发器类型。

items.source: Session repository filter order.
items.translation: 会话存储库过滤器顺序。

items.source: When to include "errors" attribute.
items.translation: 何时包含"errors"属性。

items.source: Include the "exception" attribute.
items.translation: 包含 "exception" 属性。

items.source: When to include "message" attribute.
items.translation: 何时包含"message"属性。

items.source: When to include "path" attribute.
items.translation: 何时包含"path"属性。

items.source: When to include the "trace" attribute.
items.translation: 何时包含"trace"属性。

items.source: Path of the error controller.
items.translation: 错误控制器的路径。

items.source: Whether to enable the default error page displayed in browsers in case of a server error.
items.translation: 是否启用在发生服务器错误时浏览器中显示的默认错误页面。

items.source: Locale to use. By default, this locale is overridden by the "Accept-Language" header.
items.translation: 使用的区域设置。默认情况下，此区域设置会被"Accept-Language"标头覆盖。

items.source: Define how the locale should be resolved.
items.translation: 定义如何解析区域设置。

items.source: Whether to enable default resource handling.
items.translation: 是否启用默认资源处理。

items.source: Indicate that the response message is intended for a single user and must not be stored by a shared cache.
items.translation: 指示该响应消息是专为单个用户准备的，且不得由共享缓存存储。

items.source: Indicate that any cache may store the response.
items.translation: 指示任何缓存均可存储该响应。

items.source: Maximum time the response should be cached, in seconds if no duration suffix is not specified.
items.translation: 响应可缓存的最大时间（秒），如果未指定持续时间后缀。

items.source: Indicate that once it has become stale, a cache must not use the response without re-validating it with the server.
items.translation: 指明一旦缓存项失效，则必须通过向服务器重新验证后再使用该响应。

items.source: Indicate that the cached response can be reused only if re-validated with the server.
items.translation: 指示缓存的响应仅在通过服务器重新验证后可重用。

items.source: Indicate to not cache the response in any case.
items.translation: 指示在任何情况下都不缓存响应。

items.source: Indicate intermediaries (caches and others) that they should not transform the response content.
items.translation: 指示中间件（如缓存等）不要转换响应内容。

items.source: Same meaning as the "must-revalidate" directive, except that it does not apply to private caches.
items.translation: 与"must-revalidate"指令含义相同，但不适用于私有缓存。

items.source: Maximum time the response should be cached by shared caches, in seconds if no duration suffix is not specified.
items.translation: 如果未指定持续时间后缀，则响应应由共享缓存缓存的最大时间（以秒为单位）。

items.source: Maximum time the response may be used when errors are encountered, in seconds if no duration suffix is not specified.
items.translation: 遇到错误时响应可使用的最大时间（秒），如果未指定持续时间后缀。

items.source: Maximum time the response can be served after it becomes stale, in seconds if no duration suffix is not specified.
items.translation: 响应在过期后仍可被提供的最大时间（秒），如果未指定持续时间后缀。

items.source: Cache period for the resources served by the resource handler. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used. Can be overridden by the 'spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol' properties.
items.translation: 资源处理器所服务的资源的缓存周期。如果未指定持续时间后缀，则使用秒。可被'spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol'属性覆盖。

items.source: Whether we should use the "lastModified" metadata of the files in HTTP caching headers.
items.translation: 我们是否应在 HTTP 缓存头中使用文件的"lastModified"元数据。

items.source: Whether to enable caching in the Resource chain.
items.translation: 是否在资源链中启用缓存。

items.source: Whether to enable resolution of already compressed resources (gzip, brotli). Checks for a resource name with the '.gz' or '.br' file extensions.
items.translation: 是否启用已压缩资源（gzip、brotli）的解析。检查带有 `.gz` 或 `.br` 文件扩展名的资源名称。

items.source: Whether to enable the Spring Resource Handling chain. By default, disabled unless at least one strategy has been enabled.
items.translation: 是否启用 Spring 资源处理链。默认情况下，除非已启用至少一个策略，否则该功能处于禁用状态。

items.source: Whether to enable the content Version Strategy.
items.translation: 是否启用内容版本策略。

items.source: List of patterns to apply to the content Version Strategy.
items.translation: 要应用于内容版本策略的模式列表。

items.source: Whether to enable the fixed Version Strategy.
items.translation: 是否启用固定版本策略。

items.source: List of patterns to apply to the fixed Version Strategy.
items.translation: 要应用于固定版本策略的模式列表。

items.source: Version string to use for the fixed Version Strategy.
items.translation: 用于固定版本策略的版本字符串。

items.source: Locations of static resources. Defaults to classpath:[/META-INF/resources/, /resources/, /static/, /public/].
items.translation: 静态资源的位置。默认为 classpath:[/META-INF/resources/, /resources/, /static/, /public/]。

items.source: Base path for all web handlers.
items.translation: 所有 Web 处理程序的基础路径。

items.source: Directory used to store file parts larger than 'maxInMemorySize'. Default is a directory named 'spring-multipart' created under the system temporary directory. Ignored when using the PartEvent streaming support.
items.translation: 用于存储大于“maxInMemorySize”的文件部分的目录。默认为在系统临时目录下创建的名为“spring-multipart”的目录。在使用 PartEvent 流式传输支持时会被忽略。

items.source: Character set used to decode headers.
items.translation: 用于解码标头的字符集。

items.source: Maximum amount of disk space allowed per part. Default is -1 which enforces no limits.
items.translation: 每个部分允许的最大磁盘空间量。默认为 -1，表示不限制。

items.source: Maximum amount of memory allowed per headers section of each part. Set to -1 to enforce no limits.
